name: Hugging Face
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://apply.workable.com/huggingface/: the page auto-applies a geo filter ('We've detected your location and are showing jobs in United States') and lists 5; after 'Clear filters' it lists 6 job links = the 6 feed shortcodes. The page's own /api/v1/accounts/huggingface/jobs/count returns {"total":6,"incountry":3}.
notes: huggingface.co/careers redirects here (huggingface.co/jobs is the Hub's login-only jobs product, not careers). Always POST with empty filters: the browser's second POST adds location=[US] and drops EMEA jobs.
